title: Roadmap to the Platinum
note: Built from the official trophy descriptions: the story in order with the missable trophies flagged in their stages, then the stranger strands, then the activity, collectible and money cleanups, then the platinum itself.

stages.title: Welcome to Leonida
stages.advice: Play the opening mission and Chapter 1 as they come, and sample every type of activity once while the map is new: it starts the activity count early and teaches you where the ranges, races and arcades live.

stages.title: The Story Campaign
stages.advice: Chapters 2 to 4 and the named story missions. Two trophies need your attention while you are here and cannot be tidied up later: the unscheduled departure at VCIA, and the tracked story choices behind Actions Speak Louder. Engage with every choice prompt the story offers.

stages.title: The Finale and 100%
stages.advice: Finish the final mission, then work the in-game 100% checklist down to zero. A Long Road is the real endgame: everything in the later stages feeds it.
trophies: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

stages.title: Strangers & Freaks
stages.advice: Finish all eight stranger strands across Leonida, including each character's final mission. Take Bret's unique-animal hunt the moment it is offered: a unique animal does not wait around.

stages.title: Activities, Stunts & Challenges
stages.advice: The skill-based cleanup: shooting-range golds, drone races, 250 stunts, robberies and combat feats. Spread these out; several are long grinds that go faster in short sessions.

stages.title: Collectibles, Exploration & Money
stages.advice: The state-wide sweep: card sets, WAiNK spots, meditation spots, vehicle discoveries, every area of Leonida, and the cash targets for laundering, spending and garages.

stages.title: Leonida Legend
stages.advice: When the other 54 trophies are earned, the platinum is awarded automatically. Congratulations, you are a Leonida Legend.
